scope: Rust stack-probe exact-summary default versus parent main8332, plus two candidate auto/off ablations. No samples have been taken.
criterion: Every CPU/wall ratio-of-medians and simultaneous upper mean-ratio bootstrap bound <=5 percent. One final look; no unchanged-code repeat.
execution: Nine cases on disjoint physical CPU pairs; seven compare default to parent, two named -ablation compare candidate auto to candidate off. Each two-round block has both orders randomized. No own builds/tests/corpus/backends overlap.

lightwork_reservation_amendment.reason: Reserve one physical pair for light document/code review commands; exclude it from timing workers before any samples. Acceptance, sample counts and inference unchanged.

compiled_spec_verification.scope: Assert parent and candidate compiled spec bytes against the existing 154-spec manifest before and after sampling.

failure_policy: No unchanged-code repeat or discarded observations. A failed study blocks default-on publication; revise only for a demonstrated implementation issue or ship the new summary off.
fallback: If any default or enabled ablation bound exceeds 5%, retain all samples and ship OFF in all presets. Validate and measure the changed OFF default once separately; never repeat unchanged code to chase a pass.
